name: Astrid Christensen
bio:
Astrid's path to motorsport security was unconventional, beginning with a decade in the Danish Police's bomb disposal unit. Her cool head and meticulous attention to detail proved invaluable, leading to an offer to oversee security at a local racing circuit. From there, her reputation for thoroughness and proactive risk assessment grew, eventually attracting the attention of Aston Martin's security division.

Astrid believes in a preventative approach to security, emphasizing threat analysis and personnel training. She's known for her comprehensive security protocols, which prioritize the safety of team members and assets. While maintaining a firm stance on security breaches, she fosters a collaborative environment, valuing input from all team members.

What sets Astrid apart is her ability to adapt to the ever-changing security landscape. She stays ahead of potential threats by continuously researching new technologies and methodologies, ensuring Aston Martin remains a step ahead.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly braided and pulled back into a tight bun.
physical.description: Astrid is of average height, with a lean build and a no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn copy of the Danish Penal Code.
Insists on conducting random security drills at unexpected times.
Has an uncanny ability to identify potential problems before they arise.
